title: Building an MCP Server: Stateless Python and TypeScript

questions.question: Where does a modern MCP server read client capabilities?
questions.explanation: MCP 2026-07-28 carries client capabilities in every request's params._meta.

questions.question: Which method must a modern server implement?
questions.explanation: server/discover is mandatory on modern servers, although clients may call another method first.

questions.question: Which successful result fields are required on tools/list?
questions.explanation: Modern list results are typed and cacheable.

questions.question: Why should a server sort tools deterministically?
options: To stabilize caches and model context
questions.explanation: Stable ordering makes equivalent registries produce equivalent responses.

questions.question: A valid tool call runs but the domain operation fails. Which shape fits?
options: A complete tool result with isError true
questions.explanation: Tool-level failures stay visible to the model through content and isError.

questions.question: What should end a stdio server's transport lifetime?
questions.explanation: EOF is the portable stdio shutdown signal. It does not close a modern protocol session.
